 khanna_akhil@yaahoo.co.in | +91 9999389217 | https://www.linkedin.com/in/akhil-khanna-419b9145/ 

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

First American India Pvt Ltd, Hyderabad                                                                                                             June 2021 – May 2025

Senior Software Engineer 

Designed and implemented ETL workflows using AWS Glue, Informatica, and Pyspark, improving data pipeline efficiency.

Developed and optimized data lake architecture on AWS S3, reducing storage costs.

Developed Workflow implementation on Schedule Batch update jobs using Informatica Power Center.

Have used Informatica BDM for conversion of data as per the client requirement.

Built real-time streaming solutions with Kafka and Spark Streaming, improving data ingestion speeds.

Migrated legacy on-prem data warehouse to Snowflake, enhancing query performance.

Created interactive Power BI dashboards, reducing manual reporting efforts.

Conducted ad-hoc SQL-based analysis, uncovering insights that improved operational efficiency.

Developed predictive models for customer segmentation and risk assessment, improving decision-making.

Built NLP-based text analytics solutions for customer sentiment analysis, improving service quality.

Implemented data lakes using S3, Glue, and Athena enabling analytics on huge datasets

Implemented partitioning and caching strategies reducing Spark job runtime.

Created complex data transformations and aggregations for business intelligence reporting

Build a data pipeline that ingest data to Azure Data Lake/HDFS from multiple data sources

Led the migration of data from multiple sources to ADLS gen2 thereby empowering teams to analyze it.

Led the performance initiatives that optimized the queries to yield a 70% improvement in data processing speed

rather than analyzing data in a database, move this data to a data lake and analyze it. 

Used serverless synapse for one of the most daily jobs and optimized it to scan less data by using columnar file format and other techniques

Implemented Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines integrating Hugging Face LLMs with FAISS and Pinecone for real-time customer support and knowledge base retrieval applications.

Developed end-to-end Lang Chain-based AI assistants, including dynamic prompt engineering, document loaders, and multi-hop retrieval chains for enterprise document summarization and Q&A systems.

Built production-ready ML models for classification and regression tasks using XGBoost, Random Forest, and Logistic Regression.

Proficient in supervised (classification, regression) and unsupervised learning (clustering, dimensionality reduction).

Experience with ensemble methods (Random Forest, XGBoost) and neural networks (CNNs, RNNs).

Model evaluation using cross-validation, precision-recall, ROC curves, and confusion matrices.

Migrated legacy ETL processes to Snowflake, reducing costs through storage compression and query optimization.

Implemented dynamic data masking for PII compliance.

Migrated legacy ETL processes to Snowflake, reducing costs through storage compression and query optimization.

Implemented dynamic data masking for PII compliance.

Designed and optimized ETL pipelines using Python, SQL, and Snowflake, reducing data processing time and improving reliability.
